pieces.title: Nanda Village's Siddha Baba (was in the record of the Siddha Bābā of Nandagrāma)

fields.notes: An unnamed siddha bābā who did bhajana at Paurṇamāsī-kuṇḍa near Nandagrāma in the days of Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī of Kāmyavana and Siddha Vaiṣṇava dāsa Bābā of Kosi. He lived under a tree near his kuṭīra and worshipped a Govardhana-śilā he always kept hanging from his neck in a cloth; he sat for long periods in trance, and no one knew where the food his followers cooked for Govardhana came from, yet there was always enough for any number of visitors. Told by Advaita dāsa Bābājī (#17). Taken out of the record #965, which tells of another unnamed bābā of Nandagrāma (11-11-2026).
